name: Navigation over moving platforms and gates
body: Follow-up, not in this feature's first pass. The grid is built from the static world, so a slab, a gate or a lift that moves is invisible to it: paths ignore closed gates and moving platforms. The room tests pass because those rooms use `via` waypoints and beats. Options: link nodes onto kinematic bodies while they are in range; rebuild the grid cells around a gate when it opens or shuts; or treat gates as links she can use when open.
plan: Split into three cards: navigation-features-doors-lifts-and-slabs-in-the-graph (engine), partner-waits-at-doors-rides-lifts-and-leads-over-slabs (partner), streets-and-rooftops-companion-walks-the-graph. Decisions D-146 onward in docs/decisions.md.
